summary: Franklin Resources Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its subsidiary Western Asset Management settled an SEC investigation into alleged trade allocation violations by former co-CIO Ken Leech. Western Asset agreed to pay a $100 million civil penalty into a Fair Fund, without admitting wrongdoing, and the DOJ has closed its investigation. The settlement ends all regulatory scrutiny of Western Asset. No deal terms, board recommendation, or structural mechanics apply. The filing is a settlement disclosure, not a special-situations event. Watch for any further litigation or regulatory developments, though risk-arbangle is not relevant here.
